topics.title: Coursework
topics.summary: UW leaves GenAI conditions to instructors: a course may allow, limit or prohibit use. Check the applicable instructions before using it for assessed work.
topics.scope: UW course instructions govern assessed work. Graduate School statements below are research recommendations; UW Medicine rules are not generalized to the campus. Currentness remains under review.

claims.text: UW general GenAI guidance says course instructors may allow, prohibit, or set parameters around GenAI use for their courses.

evidence.quote: Course instructors have the discretion to allow, prohibit, or put parameters around the use of GenAI.
evidence.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence General Use Guidelines

claims.text: UW Student Life guidance says using AI content generators without instructor permission may violate University academic standards.

evidence.quote: Using these technologies without your instructor's permission may violate academic standards of the University.
evidence.location: Student Life message to UW students
evidence.title: AI tools and academic integrity
